headline: LTM Q2 net profit falls QoQ, misses estimate
summary: LTM reported Q2 consolidated net profit of 13.98b rupees, down from 14.66b QoQ and below the 15b estimate. Revenue rose to 118b rupees from 116b QoQ.

headline: Stocks to Watch: Axis Bank, LTM, DLF, IDBI in focus
summary: Axis Bank rallies on strong Q2 profits, while LTM slips despite AI deal. DLF beats estimates, and IDBI jumps on Fairfax stake approval. Key earnings and deals drive market action.

headline: Mini Diamonds subsidiary launches gold idols
summary: Mini Diamonds' subsidiary Namra Jewels launches 20-100g gold and silver idols for Dussehra, expanding its retail portfolio beyond traditional jewellery.

headline: ACME Solar signs 300 MW FDRE PPA with SECI
summary: ACME Solar Holdings signed a PPA for 300 MW/1,200 MWh assured peak supply with SECI at ₹6/unit. The project integrates solar and battery storage to meet evening peak demand.

headline: India may expand carbon tracking for exporters
summary: India is reportedly considering expanding carbon-emission tracking requirements for exporters, a move that could raise compliance costs for metals, cement, and fertiliser companies.

headline: PM-KUSUM 2.0 to align solar pumps with farm schemes
summary: PM-KUSUM 2.0 may integrate solar-powered farm pumps with existing agricultural schemes, potentially benefiting solar and irrigation companies operating in the sector.

headline: LTM expects shorter AI deals to lift H2FY27 revenue
summary: LTM anticipates that shorter-cycle AI deals will accelerate revenue growth in the second half of FY27, signalling a shift in deal structure within its technology portfolio.

headline: Approved Indian seafood units for EU rise to 625
summary: The number of approved Indian seafood processing units for the European Union market has risen to 625, expanding export opportunities for companies including Coastal Corporation, Avanti Feeds, and Apex Frozen.

headline: Jewellery retailers eye 22-28% growth in Q2
summary: Jewellery retailers anticipate 22-28% revenue growth in Q2, supported by festive season demand driving sales across the sector.

headline: Awfis Space targets revenue above ₹1,800 crore in FY27
summary: Awfis Space Solutions has set a revenue target of above ₹1,800 crore for FY27, reflecting growing demand in the co-working segment across India.

headline: Urea import prices fall 59% from May peak
summary: Urea import prices have plunged 59% from their May peak, improving the cost and subsidy outlook for Indian fertiliser companies including RCF, NFL, and Chambal Fertilisers.

headline: Super-luxury housing unsold inventory rises 65%
summary: Unsold super-luxury homes across India's top eight cities have risen 65%, signalling a growing inventory glut in the high-end residential segment.

headline: HDFC Bank shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 2,38,794 HDFC Bank shares changing hands on NSE at ₹727.85, with a combined value of ₹17.38 crore.

headline: Axis Bank shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 1,28,919 Axis Bank shares changing hands on NSE at ₹1,247.90, with combined value of ₹16.09 crore.

headline: ESDS Software shares see large trade on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 2,24,769 shares of ESDS Software Solution changing hands on NSE at ₹1,469.70, with a combined value of ₹33.03 crore.

headline: ICICI Bank shares see ₹65.96 crore large trade
summary: A large-trade signal flagged ICICI Bank shares worth ₹65.96 crore at ₹1,399.00 and ₹21.71 crore at ₹1,395.20 on NSE.

headline: Zen Tech subsidiary faces ₹4 Cr fire loss
summary: A fire at Unistring Tech Solutions' Hyderabad centre damaged testing chambers. Zen Technologies estimates a ₹4 crore loss, covered by insurance, with minimal operational impact expected.

headline: Eco Recycling highlights India's urban mining potential
summary: Eco Recycling Limited cites new EU data showing 12.3 kg e-waste per person to underscore India's need for efficient recycling systems and resource recovery.

headline: Federal Bank targets NIM improvement
summary: Federal Bank expects its net interest margin to improve soon. The lender also plans to pursue new inorganic growth opportunities.

headline: Krishival Foods appoints Vivek Kumar Jain as CBO
summary: Krishival Foods has named Vivek Kumar Jain as its Chief Business Officer. Jain previously held roles at Nestlé India and Tata Consumer Products.

headline: L&T secures major contract worth over ₹150 billion
summary: Larsen & Toubro has secured a major contract valued at over ₹150 billion, marking a significant order win for the engineering and construction conglomerate.

headline: ABD starts Moradabad bottling unit
summary: Allied Blenders & Distillers commenced commercial operations at its Moradabad facility with 6 million cases capacity, strengthening backward integration in UP.

headline: Rajeev Deora raises stake in Integrated Capital to 9.008%
summary: Rajeev Kumar Deora acquired 3,98,550 shares of Integrated Capital Services Ltd via gift, increasing his holding to 9.008% from 7.881%.

headline: Supreme Court grants interim stay to Supriya Lifescience directors
summary: Supriya Lifescience Ltd reported that the Supreme Court admitted its judicial proceedings and granted an interim stay on coercive action against its directors and officers.

headline: Eiko promoter group raises stake to 18.18%
summary: Lenus Finvest, a promoter group entity, acquired 1.5 lakh shares of Eiko Lifesciences via warrant conversion, lifting its holding to 18.18% of the company's equity.

headline: Uday Jewellery shifts to job-work model
summary: Uday Jewellery Industries introduces a job-work model using customer-supplied gold to boost working capital efficiency and adds lightweight plain gold to its portfolio.

headline: Wealth First board to meet Oct 26 for share issue
summary: Wealth First Portfolio Managers will hold a board meeting on October 26, 2026, to consider issuing equity shares or warrants on a preferential basis.

headline: TCS deploys BaNCS Treasury in Sri Lanka
summary: TCS expands partnership with Indian Bank to deploy TCS BaNCS for Treasury at its Colombo branch, marking the platform's entry into Sri Lanka.

headline: Autoline auditors convert to LLP
summary: Autoline Industries' statutory auditor, Sharp & Tannan Associates, has converted into a Limited Liability Partnership. The firm will continue its audit engagement without change.

headline: Kuber Udyog open offer: Acquirers bid ₹23.35/share for 26% stake
summary: Manav Bahri and others launch mandatory open offer for Kuber Udyog Ltd to acquire 26% equity at ₹23.35 per share. Tendering period runs from October 28 to November 11, 2026.

headline: Akme Fintrade allots ₹50 Cr NCDs
summary: Akme Fintrade allotted ₹50 crore in non-convertible debentures across two series with coupons of 11.40% and 11.60%, maturing in 2028 and 2029 respectively.

headline: Jupiter Life Line secures ₹500 crore term loan
summary: Jupiter Life Line Hospitals entered a ₹500 crore term loan agreement with HDFC Bank for capital expenditure, secured by hospital assets.

headline: BLS Polymers IPO: ₹167 Cr Fresh Issue
summary: BLS Polymers Limited files DRHP for a ₹167.06 crore fresh issue. The Goa-based polymer manufacturer plans to expand capacity and fund working capital.

headline: Union Bank Q2 net profit rises 29% YoY to ₹55B
summary: Union Bank of India posted Q2 net profit of ₹55 billion, beating estimates. Asset quality improved with GNPA falling to 2.42% and provisions dropping significantly QoQ.

headline: Regency Fincorp allots ₹30 crore NCDs at 13%
summary: Regency Fincorp Limited allotted 30,000 non-convertible debentures worth ₹30 crore at a 13% coupon rate via private placement. The securities have a tenor of 36 months with partial principal redemption starting in month 24.

headline: Capri Global approves $30M USD bond issuance
summary: Capri Global Capital Ltd approved the issuance of up to USD 30 million in senior secured non-convertible bonds via private placement, listing on IFSC exchanges.

headline: Vega Jewellers hikes stake in J Hills LLP to 89.98%
summary: Vega Jewellers Ltd board approves increasing stake in Vega Jewellers J Hills LLP from 60.98% to 89.98%. Registered office shift also approved for Dec 2026.

headline: Union Bank MD flags profit margin growth as key focus
summary: Union Bank of India's Managing Director has stated that continuously enhancing profit margins remains a major focus for the bank, signalling a strategic priority on profitability.

headline: Imagicaaworld Q2FY27 Update: Footfalls dip 6%, sells Novotel
summary: Imagicaaworld Entertainment reports a 6% YoY decline in Q2FY27 footfalls due to rains. The company also approved the sale of Novotel Imagicaa for ₹248 crore and completed warrant conversions.

headline: Veerhealth Care to host investor meet Oct 24
summary: Veerhealth Care Ltd will hold virtual meetings with analysts and institutional investors on October 24, 2026. Managing Director Bhavin S. Shah and CFO Akash Shah will lead the discussions.

headline: Fractal Analytics appoints Shilpa Kedia as CFO
summary: Fractal Analytics has appointed Shilpa Kedia as its Chief Financial Officer, bringing 20 years of financial experience from Johnson & Johnson and Hindustan Unilever.

headline: SecUR Credentials board approves SAT appeal against NSE delisting order
summary: SecUR Credentials Ltd's Board approved filing an appeal before the Securities Appellate Tribunal against the NSE Delisting Committee's order dated October 9, 2026.

headline: Aarnav Fashions submits delayed AGM proceedings
summary: Aarnav Fashions Limited submitted delayed proceedings for its 43rd AGM held on September 30, 2026, citing internal process delays. The company assured measures to prevent future recurrence.

headline: Highness Microelectronics starts glass cutting line
summary: Highness Microelectronics Ltd commenced commercial production from its new glass cutting line at the Rabale plant on October 19, 2026, to boost manufacturing.

headline: BEPL Q2 net profit rises 57.5% to ₹63 crore
summary: Bhansali Engineering Polymers reported a 57.5% YoY jump in Q2 net profit to ₹63 crore, driven by revenue growth and margin expansion.

headline: Kizi Apparels board to decide on fund raising
summary: Kizi Apparels Ltd board meeting on Oct 24, 2026, will consider fund raising via preferential issue. Trading window closed for insiders until results.

symbol: SAB Events & Governance Now Media Limited
stock_name: SAB Events & Governance Now Media Limited
headline: SAB Events seeks 45-day AGM extension
summary: SAB Events & Governance Now Media board approves seeking a further 45-day extension for its 13th AGM due to pending corporate actions under the approved resolution plan.

headline: Modern Dairies Q2FY27 PAT up 33% YoY
summary: Modern Dairies reported a 33.1% YoY rise in net profit to ₹225.34 lakh for Q2FY27, despite a 9.2% decline in quarterly revenue.

headline: Aeroflex secures patent for 3D hose modeling tech
summary: Aeroflex Industries secures an Indian patent for automated 3D modeling of braided hoses, enhancing R&D capabilities and supporting its expansion into AI data center liquid cooling systems.

headline: Sakuma Exports board to meet Oct 23 on fund raising
summary: Sakuma Exports Ltd will hold a board meeting on October 23, 2026, to consider proposals for raising funds through equity or convertible instruments.

headline: UltraTech Cement Q2 net profit rises to ₹14.9B
summary: UltraTech Cement reported Q2 consolidated net profit of ₹14.9B rupees, up from ₹12.3B a year ago, missing the analyst estimate of ₹15.53B.

headline: Ultratech Q2 volume up 14%; vice chair change
summary: Ultratech Cement reports 14% Q2 cement volume growth, missing 15% estimates. K.K. Maheshwari resigns as non-executive vice chairman effective January 1, 2027, with K.C. Jhanwar succeeding him.

headline: UltraTech Cement approves USD 55 mn guarantee
summary: UltraTech Cement's board approved a USD 55 million corporate guarantee for associate UHG Holdings IFSC Private Limited. The transaction is arm's length.

headline: Dynacons named Leading Mid-Corporate of India 2026
summary: Dynacons Systems & Solutions Ltd has been recognized as one of the Leading Mid-Corporates of India 2026 by Dun & Bradstreet, highlighting its growth in IT infrastructure and digital transformation services.

headline: Advit Jewels promoter Vipul Gilara transfers 16.98% stake
summary: Vipul Gilara disposed of 77,78,430 shares of Advit Jewels Ltd via inter-se transfer on October 16, 2026. His holding reduced to 17.40%.

headline: Tata Technologies to host investor meet in Mumbai
summary: Tata Technologies Limited will conduct a non-deal roadshow and analyst meeting in Mumbai on October 22, 2026. The event is scheduled from 9:30 am to 7:00 pm.

headline: RR Metalmakers open offer price revised to ₹36.83
summary: SEBI directs RR Metalmakers open offer price hike to ₹36.83 per share due to historical non-compliance. Acquirers to pay compensatory interest on 26% stake acquisition.

headline: CARE Ratings sells 19.8% stake in CareEdge Global IFSC
summary: CARE Ratings executed SPAs to sell 9.90% each in CareEdge Global IFSC to SBI and NSE IFSC, reducing its holding to 80.20%.

headline: Mirza International sets up footwear subsidiary
summary: Mirza International Limited incorporated Mirza Footwear Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary, to enter manufacturing and e-commerce. The new entity has an authorised share capital of ₹15 lakh.

headline: Ashoka Buildcon redeems ₹100 crore CPs on maturity
summary: Ashoka Buildcon redeemed its entire ₹100 crore commercial paper issue along with interest of ₹174.44 lakh on October 19, 2026. The full redemption marks the completion of the debt obligation.

headline: Natco Pharma launches Carboplatin generic in US
summary: Natco Pharma Ltd announced the launch of Carboplatin Injection, a generic of Paraplatin, in the US market. The product addresses a critical shortage and had estimated sales of $27.8 million in the 12 months ending June 2026.

headline: NCLT rejects Dharan Infra-EPC withdrawal plea
summary: The NCLT Mumbai Bench dismissed Dharan Infra-EPC's application to withdraw its Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process. The company remains under IBC proceedings.

headline: Kwality Pharma buys 4 acres for Amritsar expansion
summary: Kwality Pharmaceuticals acquires 4 acres in Amritsar to build a fully automated facility with injectable and oral lines, targeting Q4 FY28 completion.

headline: Wanbury facilities win safety and HR awards
summary: Wanbury Limited's Tanuku and Patalganga API manufacturing sites received awards for employee practices and safety performance from state and national bodies.

headline: CL Educate board approves DEXIT merger
summary: CL Educate Limited approved the amalgamation of wholly owned subsidiary DEXIT Global. The scheme requires NCLT approval and involves no share issuance or cash consideration.

headline: Punj Lloyd AGM to adopt FY26 accounts
summary: Punj Lloyd Ltd will hold its 38th AGM on September 30, 2026, to adopt FY26 financials and appoint directors.

headline: GEM Enviro acquires 75% stake in Novuscom Neo
summary: GEM Enviro Management acquires 75% equity and CCPS in Novuscom Neo for ₹30 lakh. The target, an ESG research firm, becomes a subsidiary.

headline: Nuvama flags earnings headwinds from oil and El Nino
summary: Nuvama Wealth Management warns of moderating corporate top lines in H2 due to weak incomes, El Nino, and oil shocks. Equities valuations remain near 2024 peaks despite two years of flat markets.

headline: Kalyani Steels shareholders approve Ajay Kirtane as director
summary: Kalyani Steels shareholders approved the appointment of Ajay Kirtane as Independent Director via postal ballot. The special resolution passed with 99.98% votes in favour.

headline: Millworks sets up 3D printing centre with Markforged
summary: Millworks Technologies Limited established a Centre of Excellence for 3D printing in Bengaluru, partnering with Markforged to enhance aerospace and defence capabilities.

headline: Ramesh Saraogi raises stake in Advit Jewels to 6.55%
summary: Ramesh Sawalram Saraogi and PAC Navratri Share Trading acquired 2 lakh shares of Advit Jewels Ltd via open market, lifting combined holding to 6.5488%.

headline: EPL gets NCLT nod for Indovida merger
summary: EPL Limited received no adverse observation letters from BSE and NSE for its proposed merger with Indovida India Private Limited, clearing a key regulatory hurdle.

headline: RVNL ED Ashutosh Gautam moves to NBCC
summary: Rail Vikas Nigam Ltd confirmed the cessation of Executive Director (Highway) Ashutosh Gautam on October 19, 2026, to join NBCC as Director (Projects).

headline: Titan Company redeems ₹1,000 crore CPs
summary: Titan Company Limited has fully redeemed commercial papers worth ₹1,000 crore issued in July 2026. The maturity proceeds were paid to all holders on October 19, 2026.

headline: Makers Labs shareholders approve director appointment
summary: Makers Laboratories shareholders passed the resolution to appoint Saahil Parikh as Non-Executive Director via postal ballot with 99.99% votes in favour.
